def flatten_groups(nums):
    res = []
    for i in nums:
        if isinstance(i, Iterable):
            for x in i:
                res.append(x)
        else:
            res.append(i)
    return res


def _canonical_group_size(size):
    # Dynamic cat/view graphs can represent the same product in expanded and
    # factored SymPy forms.  Codegen scheduling compares group sizes directly,
    # so canonicalize scalar expressions before matching reduction epilogues.
    if isinstance(size, sympy.Expr):
        return V.graph.sizevars.simplify(size)
    return size

问题描述
Qwen-Image-2.1 推理指南需要区分 true CFG 与 CFG 并行，避免不传负向提示词时使用 2 路 CFG 造成冗余计算；同时补齐镜像部署、机型与量化说明。
预期修改
基础请求不启用 true CFG，提供单卡及 8 卡 Ulysses 配置，简述启用 true CFG 的条件。
使用支持模型的官方镜像部署，补充 Atlas 800I A2 推理服务器与 Atlas 800I A3 超节点服务器。
修正编辑请求省略 size 时使用第一张参考图像的说明。
使用 FLASH_ATTN 后端调用 MindIE-SD 注意力算子，补充 INT8、MXFP8 在线量化完整命令及范围说明。
保留必要使用说明，删除优化点罗列。
验收方式
核对参数与接口含义，通过改动文件的 pre-commit、Markdown、Bash/JSON 和 diff 检查；运行验证范围在 PR 中单独注明。

static void ReportInferShapeExecutionError(const char* opName, const char* reason)
{
    const std::string opNameStr(opName == nullptr ? "" : opName);
    const std::string reasonStr(reason == nullptr ? "" : reason);
    const std::string msg = "Failed to execute operator " + opNameStr + ". Reason: " + reasonStr + ".";
    const std::vector<const char*> msgKey = {"opName", "reason"};
    const std::vector<const char*> msgValue = {opNameStr.c_str(), reasonStr.c_str()};
    OP_LOGE_WITHOUT_REPORT(opNameStr.c_str(), "%s", msg.c_str());
    REPORT_PREDEFINED_ERR_MSG("EZ1014", msgKey, msgValue);
}

template <typename T>
static inline bool GetAxisValue(gert::InferShapeContext* context, int64_t dimIdx, int64_t& axisValue)
{
    // 注意: 此处必须按 IR anchor 索引取 tensor(GetRequiredInputTensor), 不能用扁平索引(GetInputTensor),
    // 因为 x 为动态输入, concat_dim 的扁平位置随实例数变化
    auto tensor = context->GetRequiredInputTensor(dimIdx);
    if (tensor == nullptr) {
        return false;
    }
    auto ptr = tensor->GetData<T>();
    if (ptr == nullptr) {
        // 编译期轴值不可得(Data-feed): 由调用方兜底, 不在此处报错
        return false;
    }
    axisValue = static_cast<int64_t>(ptr[0]);
    return true;
}

描述
Broadcast 公共 tiling 路径为不使用 GM workspace 的 Vector 算子预留了冗余系统空间。本次在
BroadcastBaseTiling::DoTiling
的成功出口调用
GetWorkspaceSizes(1)
、检查返回指针并显式写入 0，替换默认系统 workspace 预留。
修改集中于一个公共头文件，一维、广播和非连续调度共用该出口；不在各算子重复覆盖 workspace，不改变 tiling key、分块计算或 kernel 数值逻辑。本 PR 不修改 CMake。

未关联独立 Issue。

ops-math PR 6242
ops-nn PR 11789
ops-transformer PR 13661
依赖接入顺序：本 PR 合入后，依赖方固定到包含该补丁的上游 commit ID。无需新增本地源码覆盖、缓存切换或远程仓库选择逻辑。现有联调通过本地工作副本接入补丁，不代表依赖方默认远程固定版本已更新。
测试
环境：Ascend950PR_9579，CANN 9.2.0（20260909 工具链）。
公共依赖同版本正反对照：未修改公共代码时 Math Host UT 171/333 通过，162 个 workspace 断言失败；恢复补丁后 333/333 通过。
新增 Add 非连续 stride 与已初始化 workspace 覆盖测试后，Math Host UT 334/334 通过。
Math 39 算子 430 项固定输入设备回放，以及新增 78 项大规模候选，binary 比较与独立输出原始字节比较均通过；workspace 为 0，越界检查通过，tiling key/data/blockDim 不变。
小 shape 按基线 <20 us、允许 1 us 波动；大 shape 允许 <5% 波动。Math 大规模初轮 AxpyV2 广播 +5.39%，修改前 → 修改后 → 修改后 → 修改前、每轮 100 次启动复测为 +1.1165%，落入容差。

{
    if (inShape.IsScalar()) {

    }
    return inShape;
}

struct BroadcastComputeParams {
    int64_t maxDtypeBits;
    int64_t minDtypeBits;
    std::vector<int64_t> extraSize;
    std::vector<int64_t> bufferDivisor;
};

/**
 *  @brief tiling切分参数
 * - coreNum 核数大小
 * - inShape 输入shape大小
 * - outShape 输出shape大小
 * - ubSize ub空间大小
 * - computeMap 不同数据类型对应的compute参数
 */
struct BroadcastTilingParams {
    int64_t coreNum;
    std::vector<gert::Shape> inShape;
    std::vector<gert::Stride> inStride;
    gert::Shape outShape;
    int64_t ubSize;
    // 仅对连续路径（inputAllContiguous=true）生效；非连续路径默认多核优先，忽略此参数
    bool preferMultiCore = false;
    bool inputAllContiguous = true;
    std::map<uint64_t, BroadcastComputeParams> computeMap;
};

/**
 *  @brief 编译参数信息
 * - dslCompileInfo dsl分支场景的compileInfo信息
 * - isAscendC 是否走AscendC分支标记
 * - coreNum 核数大小
 * - ubSize ub空间大小
 */
struct BroadcastCompileInfo {
    // std::shared_ptr<AutoTilingCompileInfo> dslCompileInfo;
    bool isAscendC{false};
    uint64_t coreNum = 0;
    uint64_t ubSize = 0;
};

/**
 *  @brief 公共切分tiling结构体
 * - dims 输入shape信息
 * - strides 输入shape轴的stride信息
 * - outputDims 输出dim大小
 * - innerKey 工具化场景下的key值
 * - shapeLen 输出shape长度
 * - ubSplitAxis ub切分轴
 * - ubFormer ub切分大小
 * - blockFormer 多核切分大小
 * - ubOuter ub切分外循环轴
 * - ubTail ub切分尾块大小
 * - blockNum 多核切分大小
 * - blockTail 多核切分尾块大小

Describe the current behavior / 问题描述 (Mandatory / 必填)
examples/07_tuner_plugin/plugin.cpp::ParseMatchField
直接使用 nlohmann/json 的
get<uint32_t/size_t/uint64_t>()
。这些数值转换不保证拒绝窄化或负数回绕。实测将
min_ranks
、
max_ranks
均设为
4294967304
（2^32+8）时，两者被转换为 8，schema 未报错，插件错误命中实际 8-rank 通信域并将原算法 cost 从 2 改为 0。
这是用户配置输入导致错误干预算法选择的功能问题，不要求真实部署 2^32 个 rank。配置若不可由目标类型表示，应沿用现有 schema 失败策略，保留原 cost。13 个无符号整数字段具有同一转换根因，一并修复；本次不改上一轮的 Python 性能测量数据，也不改变浮点 cost 的语义。

GetRes() 是 HcclResult 虚接口，基类实现明确返回 HCCL_E_INTERNAL。当前实现不传播任一模板资源错误，也没有验证 threads_.size() 是否覆盖三个 count；无效资源请求或线程不足时会产生越界迭代器。后续 GenTempResource() 复用 levels_[idx].threads，故问题会进入模板 KernelRun，而不是在资源准备阶段确定失败。

using namespace AscendC;
导致编译失败；

CHECK_RET
不带日志信息，定位成本高。
Benefit / Necessity（价值/作用）
tiling 与 kernel 行为口径统一，降低后续修改回归风险；
补齐入参与输出校验，把非法 shape/stride 挡在 Host 侧，避免核上越界；
修复 arch92 旧常量引用、空输入除零、910B Host 编译失败等问题；
清理死代码与无用头文件，报错与示例更易读易定位。
Design（设计方案）
tiling 规范整改
：属性一次性读取并统一
int64
校验，整改 32 位宽化与溢出隐患；
CheckFeature
校验落点统一，补充
cu_seqlens
首维、输出形状、stride 下界校验；清理死代码、无用头文件与未使用的参数结构体。
kernel / VF 收敛
：kernel 与 tiling 复用公共
ceil-div
/
align
；统一模板参数与命名，除法改位移；提取 vf 公共常量，VF 尾部统一按循环处理，统一循环计数器口径。
缺陷修复
：arch92 融合路径旧常量引用；切分在空输入时除零；输出形状与 stride 下界校验补齐；910B 公共 Host 编译失败。
示例与报错
：example 的
CHECK_RET
改为传入日志信息与错误码；报错文本去掉重复算子名。

attention/
（compressor 29、quant_compressor 31、compressor_grad 5）。

[Performance] causal_conv1d: FP32 cast-once ring — up to 1.44× device


# What this PR does / why we need it?



# causal_conv1d: FP32 cast-once ring



Optimizes the AscendC `causal_conv1d` kernel (`csrc/moe/causal_conv1d`). **Bit-exact to `main`** (zero numerical change) while running **1.251× faster on device / 1.215× end-to-end across a full 48-config sweep, and up to 1.44× at the production width `dim=6144`.** Validated inside vllm-ascend's real Qwen3.5 GDN layer.



## What changed



Three complementary changes, all preserving the exact output:



1. **FP32 "cast-once" ring buffer.** The conv state/history ring is kept in **FP32** through the rolling prefill path; we cast **once** at history load and once at final state writeback, instead of casting `bf16 ↔ fp32` on every per-token use. This removes the dominant redundant cast traffic from the inner loop (`bias=true`/generic accumulation benefits most — that's where the 1.34–1.44× comes from).

2. **Even `3072 + 3072` tiling.** `MAX_DIM_TILE_SIZE` `4096 → 3072`, so the production width `dim=6144` splits into **two equal 3072 tiles** instead of one 4096 tile + a 2048 remainder — balanced tiles, better locality.

3. **Register-base rolling-output compute.** FP32 ring values are loaded straight into registers and fed to `MulAdd` without an intermediate cast + pipe barrier.



**Correctness is preserved by design:** the single-token decode/update path stays byte-identical to `main`, the persisted `conv_state` remains `bf16`, and the FP32→bf16 round-trip uses the same rounding as `main`'s cas

 // 固定写法，创建OpExecutor
    auto uniqueExecutor = CREATE_EXECUTOR();

    auto ret = CheckParams(weight, indices, offsets, getModeStr(mode), perSampleWeights, includeLastOffset, output,
                           offset2bag, bagSize, maxIndices);
    if (ret != ACLNN_SUCCESS) {

    if (weight->IsEmpty() || indices->IsEmpty() || offsets->IsEmpty()) {

    auto weightContiguous = l0op::Contiguous(weight, uniqueExecutor.get());
    auto indicesContiguous = l0op::Contiguous(indices, uniqueExecutor.get());
    auto offsetsContiguous = l0op::Contiguous(offsets, uniqueExecutor.get());

static inline bool CheckMathType(const aclTensor* self, const aclTensor* mat2, int8_t cubeMathType)
{
    bool mat2Float = mat2->GetDataType() == DataType::DT_FLOAT;
    bool selfFloat = self->GetDataType() == DataType::DT_FLOAT;
    auto promoteType = (mat2Float || selfFloat) ? DataType::DT_FLOAT : self->GetDataType();
    return CheckCubeMathTypeForMm(promoteType, cubeMathType);
}

static inline bool CheckKEqual1Support(void)
{
    return (op::GetCurrentPlatformInfo().GetCurNpuArch() == NpuArch::DAV_2201);
}

static inline bool CheckNpuArchIsSupportBf16(void)
{
    auto npuArch = op::GetCurrentPlatformInfo().GetCurNpuArch();
    return (npuArch == NpuArch::DAV_2201) || (npuArch == NpuArch::DAV_3510);
}

static inline bool CheckMMV3NzNzNdSupport(MmOpInfo& mmOpInfo)
{
    // 当前切换场景不支持输入self、mat2、bias混精度场景，且输入类型只支持fp16、bf16、fp32
    if (mmOpInfo.ori_info.self_dtype != mmOpInfo.ori_info.mat2_dtype ||
        (mmOpInfo.ori_info.bias_dtype <= DataType::DT_MAX &&
         mmOpInfo.support_info.self_dtype != mmOpInfo.support_info.bias_dtype) ||
        ALIGN_UNIT_MAP.find(mmOpInfo.ori_info.self_dtype) == ALIGN_UNIT_MAP.end()) {
        return false;
    }
    return (op::GetCurrentPlatformInfo().GetCurNpuArch() == NpuArch::DAV_2201);
}

描述
InstanceNorm（Ascend950 arch35）空归约兜底模板
InstanceNormReduceEmpty
（R==0 且 N*C>0 时进入，tilingKey=50000）原先将 mean/variance 双双填 NaN。该填充值与以下三方均不一致：
参照
空归约填充约定
PyTorch CUDA welford（torch 2.7.0+cu126 / 2.14.1+cu130 双版本实测，A100）
save_mean=
0
/ save_invstd=NaN
仓内同语义空模板
add_layer_norm_regbase_reduce_empty.h
（其文件注释即写明"mean=[A,1] 填 0、rstd=[A,1] 填 NaN"）
mean=
0
/ rstd=NaN
aclnnBatchNorm L2 空进填充（
ProcessEmptyTensorWithValue(saveMean, 0)
/
saveInvstd, NaN)
）
saveMean=
0
/ saveInvstd=NaN
本改动将空归约时 mean 填充值改为
0
（variance 保持 NaN），并把实现方式对齐
add_layer_norm_regbase_reduce_empty
：同一 buffer 分两段填充 0 和 NaN 后循环搬出（原先共用一个 NaN tensor 拷给两路输出）。
实际影响面有限（torch 对外不暴露 instance_norm 统计量、InstanceNormGrad 空模板自身填 0 不消费统计量输出），但以 torch 逐实例统计量为 golden 的精度对比会出现 NaN vs 0 的假红；且本改动消除 CANN 生态内同一"空归约"语义下两种填充约定的分叉。
验证
环境：Ascend950PR + CANN 9.3.0，master (63513a9e2) 构建
--ops=instance_norm --soc=ascend950 --pkg
，以自定义算子包（ASCEND_CUSTOM_OPP_PATH）覆盖内置二进制
空进非空出用例
x=(2,4,0,3) fp32/NCHW：mean=0、variance=NaN，与更新后 golden 精确匹配（ttk kernel 模式 PASS）
正常 shape 对

现象
Atlas A3 上，直方图/分箱族算子（torch.bucketize / torch.bincount / torch.histc）出现三档崩溃级失败：
案例
算子与条件
失败形态
bk_right_true
torch.bucketize(..., right=True)
SIGSEGV（exit=-11）
，错误串：
rtGetDevMsg execution failed, the context is a null pointer.
bc_weights_f64

（f64 权重）
exit=1

（error_message_manage.cc:76）
hc_range_drops

（range 参数含边界丢弃场景）
exit=1
FuncError
（同上）
其中 bucketize 的 SIGSEGV 不是普通的 Python 异常——
context is a null pointer
表明
设备上下文被打穿
，属于崩溃级缺陷。同批对照算子（其余 binning 案例及 cat/copy 全案）在 A3 上全部通过，失败面精确锁定。

：searchsorted int32 序列 × int64 values 组合返回值与 CPU 不一致（同 dtype exact 判比下 DIVERGE）——直方图族的跨芯行为均不干净。

CANN 9.2.1（社区版），Atlas A3，openEuler 容器
torch 2.11.0 + torch_npu 2.11.0rc1（pip）

[BugFix][Attention] Keep SFA q up-projection batch-invariant past 65536 packed tokens
### What this PR does / why we need it?

`AscendSFAImpl._q_proj_and_k_up_proj` projected `q_nope` with
`npu_transpose_batchmatmul` while `q_nope.shape[0] < TRANSPOSE_BMM_MAX_SUPPORTED_DIM`
(65536), and fell back to `transpose -> torch.bmm -> transpose` otherwise.

`q_nope.shape[0]` is the token count of the *current launch*, i.e. the packed
prefill batch, not the length of a single request. Since the two paths do not
round identically, the same prompt got a different projection as soon as one
prefill step packed 65536 tokens or more. With `VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT=1` that is a
batch-invariance violation: BS=1 and BS=N produce different logits for the same
request, and the first sampled token already diverges.

This PR always uses the fused operator, but launches it on a fixed token grid of
`TRANSPOSE_BMM_CHUNK` = `TRANSPOSE_BMM_MAX_SUPPORTED_DIM - 1` tokens. The split is
sound because the fused op is row independent; the grid size is deliberately the
largest launch the old guard already allowed, so **any token count that already
took a single launch keeps exactly one launch with unchanged arguments** -- the
only shapes whose behaviour changes are the ones that used to fall back to
`torch.bmm`. The `torch.bmm` path is kept only for unsupported dtypes and for
`torch_npu` builds without the fused op.

Measurements on Ascend 910 (A3, build platform `ascend910_93`), torch_npu
2.10.0.post4, GLM-5.x DSA models:

- The two paths disagree on identical input at identical T: 7622 / 167,772,

描述
修复 Ascend 950 上
QuantLightningIndexer
的 FP8 E4M3 TopK 结果随 query 长度变化的问题。完整 prefill 和 chunked prefill 对同一 query 使用相同的 Q、K、权重、反量化系数和因果范围时，仍可能选出不同的索引。
arch35 的单行路径分别累加偶数和奇数 head 后再相加，双行路径按 head 顺序逐项累加。FP32 舍入差异会影响 BF16 排序分数，进而改变 TopK 边界。本改动让 FP8 双行任务中的每一行复用单行规约顺序。
关联的 Issue
暂无。
测试
Ascend 950DT、CANN 9.2.1、torch_npu 2.10.0.post7。基于同一上游提交 4197a29c 分别构建原版和补丁版算子。
新增独立合成回归，使用 TND/PA_BSND、因果模式和 TopK=2048。比较 Q 长度为 2、64、314、5688 时倒数第二行的 TopK。原版在 5688 时选择索引 2048，补丁版四种长度均选中预期索引 2047。
GLM-5.3 W4A4C8 MXFP4，单机 TP8，同时开启 HiSparse、MTP=3 和前缀缓存。三轮真实 8 并发共 72 组冷/热对照，一轮真实 4 并发含两条约 128K 输入共 12 组对照。生成 token ID 和返回的 logprob 全部一致。
算子延迟变化尚未单独评估。
文档更新
无。

__simd_callee__ inline void BroadcastLaneV1(AscendC::Reg::RegTensor<float>& dst, __ubuf__ float* src, uint16_t laneIdx)
{
    AscendC::Reg::LoadAlign<float, AscendC::Reg::LoadDist::DIST_BRC_B32>(dst, src + laneIdx);
}

                                                           Reg::MaskMergeMode::ZEROING, RoundMode::UNKNOWN};

    Reg::Muls(regQK0[0], regQK0[0], mulsScalar, qliMaskB32);
    Reg::Muls(regQK0[1], regQK0[1], mulsScalar, qliMaskB32);

[Bug][GLM-5.2-W4A8C8][co-located] Stochastic async MTP enters a parser-before periodic raw-token loop
## Why this is a separate report

This is an independent **two-node co-located** reproduction, not P/D disaggregation. It is related to #14463 and #14656, but adds two isolation results that those issue bodies do not contain:

1. the failure reproduces through the vLLM OpenAI-compatible endpoint directly, bypassing the agent harness, LiteLLM, and the API gateway;
2. `return_token_ids=true` proves that the periodic loop already exists in the engine's raw output token IDs before GLM tool parsing.

The symptom eventually becomes repeated or unterminated `tool_calls[].function.arguments`, but the parser is downstream of the first observed corruption in this case.

## Impact

In a production-style agent request, approximately 0.9%-1.0% of default-sampling requests entered a long-running periodic token loop. They continued returning HTTP 200 SSE chunks until a 300-second client protection timeout, with no terminal `finish_reason`, usage chunk, or `[DONE]`. If the incomplete tool call is persisted and sent back in a later turn, downstream JSON parsing reports `Unterminated string` and returns HTTP 400.

## Reproduction statistics

All runs used the same request shape and called the serving endpoint directly:

| Arm | Result |
|---|---:|
| default model sampling, concurrency 4 | 991/1000 completed; 9/1000 timed out at 300 s |
| independent default-sampling repeat, concurrency 4 | 297/300 completed; 3/300 timed out at 300 s |
| `temperature=0`, concurrency 4 | 300/300 completed; 0/300

[Bug][GLM-5.2-W4A8C8][co-located] Stochastic async MTP enters a parser-before periodic raw-token loop
## Why this is a separate report

This is an independent **two-node co-located** reproduction, not P/D disaggregation. It is related to #14463 and #14656, but adds two isolation results that those issue bodies do not contain:

1. the failure reproduces through the vLLM OpenAI-compatible endpoint directly, bypassing the agent harness, LiteLLM, and the API gateway;
2. `return_token_ids=true` proves that the periodic loop already exists in the engine's raw output token IDs before GLM tool parsing.

The symptom eventually becomes repeated or unterminated `tool_calls[].function.arguments`, but the parser is downstream of the first observed corruption in this case.

## Impact

In a production-style agent request, approximately 0.9%-1.0% of default-sampling requests entered a long-running periodic token loop. They continued returning HTTP 200 SSE chunks until a 300-second client protection timeout, with no terminal `finish_reason`, usage chunk, or `[DONE]`. If the incomplete tool call is persisted and sent back in a later turn, downstream JSON parsing reports `Unterminated string` and returns HTTP 400.

## Reproduction statistics

All runs used the same request shape and called the serving endpoint directly:

| Arm | Result |
|---|---:|
| default model sampling, concurrency 4 | 991/1000 completed; 9/1000 timed out at 300 s |
| independent default-sampling repeat, concurrency 4 | 297/300 completed; 3/300 timed out at 300 s |
| `temperature=0`, concurrency 4 | 300/300 completed; 0/300 observed timeouts |

The zero failures in 300 greedy requests are evidence that stochastic sampling is a trigger/risk factor; they are not claimed as proof of a complete fix.

The request did **not** set `tool_choice`, `strict`, or `temperature`. It therefore used auto tool choice and the model's default generation configuration (`temperature=1.0`, `top_p=0.95`).

背景
PR #15358 合入后，
engram_fetch_train
返回
fetched_sf
时仍把真实 CPU
sf_table
作为 CustomOp 输入。该张量只用于推导输出 shape/dtype，kernel 实际读取的是 NPU 上的
sf_table_addr
。Dynamo/FakeTensor 会检查同一 CustomOp 的全部 tensor 输入，因此训练图模式打开 FP8 时会报 CPU/NPU 混设备。
修改
训练 schema 将
Tensor sf_table
替换为
ScalarType sf_dtype
和
int sf_packs
。
Python 直接传
torch.dtype
，C++ 直接接收
at::ScalarType
，删除
6
/
44
这类 PyTorch 枚举数值映射。
sf_table_addr
继续作为 kernel 使用的映射主机表地址输入。
ElasticBuffer.engram_write()
缓存 SF dtype/packs，
_wait_train
不再保留 CPU
sf
张量。
Meta/C++ 双路径校验
sf_packs >= 0
与 SF dtype 白名单，并在输出分配前完成校验。
新增公开 schema 测试，覆盖 supported dtype 输出分配、非法 dtype、负 packs，同时走 FakeTensor/Meta 与真实 NPU dispatch。
验证
构建与静态检查
head：
635d6fa17f7fb981971b823d464cd6db0ca26f9e
torch_extension wheel 与三算子 run 包构建、安装、源码一致性检查通过。
npu_elastic_buffer
JIT 重新编译通过，实际 schema 为
ScalarType sf_dtype
。
py_compile
、
ruff check
、
ruff format --check
、
clang-format
、
pre-commit
、OAT 通过。
GitCode CI 已触发，
ci_state_passed=true
。
Schema 与功能覆盖
A5_8P + torch/torch_npu 2.7.1 上，公开 schema UT 3/3 通过。
当前 head 功能覆盖验证：
local 推理 BF16 graph：PASS
local 推理 FP16 graph：PASS
local 推理 FP8 e

[BugFix]fix DeepSeek-V4 PIECEWISE ACLGraph accuracy
## Summary



This PR fixes an accuracy issue for DeepSeek-V4 when running with PIECEWISE ACLGraph mode on Ascend.



DeepSeek-V4 DSA attention uses the Ascend custom op `vllm::dsa_forward`, but PIECEWISE splitting only added `vllm::mla_forward` as an Ascend custom attention boundary. As a result, the DSA attention path was not treated as a split boundary and could be captured inside a regular PIECEWISE graph segment, leading to incorrect outputs.



This change adds `vllm::dsa_forward` to `compilation_config.splitting_ops` together with `vllm::mla_forward`.



## Changes



- Add `vllm::dsa_forward` to PIECEWISE `splitting_ops`.



## Why



`vllm::dsa_forward` wraps the DeepSeek-V4 DSA attention path. It depends on runtime `forward_context` metadata, KV cache state, sparse attention metadata,and mutates the provided `output` tensor.



Because of these dynamic side effects, it must be handled as a PIECEWISE split boundary instead of being captured inside a normal graph segment.

        # get custom compile backend for graph fusion
        compilation_config.oot_compiler = cls.get_compile_backend()

        if compilation_config.cudagraph_mode == CUDAGraphMode.NONE:
            compilation_config.mode = CompilationMode.NONE
            ascend_config.ascend_compilation_config.enable_npugraph_ex = False
        elif compilation_config.cudagraph_mode == CUDAGraphMode.PIECEWISE:
            logger.info("PIECEWISE compilation enabled on NPU. use_inductor not supported - using only ACL Graph mode")
            assert compilation_config.mode == CompilationMode.VLLM_COMPILE, (
                "When enabling VLLM_COMPILE aclgraph, please make sure compilation_config.mode == "
                "CompilationMode.VLLM_COMPILE and compilation_config.cudagraph_mode == CUDAGraphMode.VLLM_COMPILE"
            )
            compilation_config.set_splitting_ops_for_v1(
                all2all_backend=vllm_config.parallel_config.all2all_backend,
                data_parallel_size=vllm_config.parallel_config.data_parallel_size,
            )
            compilation_config.use_inductor = False
            # NOTE: Theoretically, we should also add vllm::mla_forward in the attention ops.
            # Since the process is created in the spawn mode, the value of the class attribute
            # attention ops transmitted is still the one before modification, so it has not been modified.
            # This will cause in scenarios where both piecewise and splitting ops are configured simultaneously,
            # If splitting ops does not contain the vllm::mla forward value, this configuration issue will
            # not be detected in advance assert.
            compilation_config.splitting_ops.extend(["vllm::mla_forward", "vllm::dsa_forward"])
            update_aclgraph_sizes(vllm_config)
            ascend_config.ascend_compilation_config.enable_npugraph_ex = False
        elif (
            compilation_config.cudagraph_mode == CUDAGraphMode.FULL_DECODE_ONLY
            or compilation_config.cudagraph_mode == CUDAGraphMode.FULL
        ):
            logger.info(
                "FULL_DECODE_ONLY compilation enabled on NPU. use_inductor not supported - using only ACL Graph mode"
            )
            compilation_config.use_inductor = False

[Bug-Report|缺陷反馈]: 保序AllReduce非整除尾块超出CCL buffer
#923
m0_54008281
Add on
7 days ago
Closed at
6 days ago
m0_54008281
7 days ago
Create
7 days ago
Create
保序AllReduce在单轮元素数不能被rankSize整除且接近CCL buffer容量上限时，ReduceScatter尾块写入可能越界。大数据量多轮执行时，最后一轮也可能触发。
复现条件：实际CCL buffer为200MiB，8个rank，FP32，每rank输入26,214,399个元素。前后半区各100MiB，末rank的尾块为3,276,806个元素，接收8份尾块需要104,857,792字节，比后半区容量多192字节。仿真在SendSingleRankSlice调用HcommWriteOnThread时返回HCCL_E_MEMORY。实际buffer改为400MiB后，对应边界仍存在相同问题。
原因是OrchestrateLoop只限制每轮总数据量，没有计入余数全部追加到末rank分片后，rankSize份尾块占用的临时空间。
拟在OrchestrateLoop中按实际后半区容量限制尾块大小，将放不下的余数留到下一轮；保留原有每轮总量上限和RS/AG模板。整除及原本安全的轮次保持原有分块。

RC-058 · sd2.0 pro loss nan · 未找到

1．周报描述、原根因及来源

sd2.0 pro loss nan

原JSONL第58行；指针 /fault/reported_root_cause；原行SHA 0a81d6f59a1fc343932d39dc8c97f56c7ac07b693153fd748fa248c43e0927c6

32卡多step采集，看到step 8 loss nan，step6 dump采下来数据看到rank0的all2all输出nan，输入正常→ 排查其他卡的同一个all2all，发现rank3和rank7的这个all2all输入有nan→ 往上找发现两个rank都是在truediv反向出的nan，但是输入有nan 找对应代码看到是pool里的反向进来就nan→ 看前向代码，pool后面跟了几个自定义算子，然后这一段在dump数据里是缺失的，最近能对应上dump数据的是index select的反向数据，这个跟在几个自定义算子之后，它反向数据正常→ 给这几个自定义算子的正向输出tensor挂grad hook，遇到nan就报日志→ 发现grad最早出现在attn的gradv上→确定算子在attn的反向 →对attn反向的中间tensor挂grad hook，用相同方式加nan检测打印→发现结果

2．可信资料一致性

RELATED_SCOPE：周报追到attn gradv；DTS为FA内存扫描/GM置NaN，未说明相同NaN产生位置。

摘要按可信资料采用；本阶段未重新读取内部Wiki/DTS原文。

RC-058:dts_facts:0
{
  "problem": "FA 接口部分用例使用 oom 包检测报错；GM 置 nan 测试时输出结果仍为 nan。",
  "root_cause": "初步结论为空，未给出原因。",
  "key_quote": "FA接口部分用例使用oom包检测报错，GM置nan测试时输出结果存在nan",
  "read_status": "READABLE"
}

3．采用根因与关系解释

32卡多step采集，看到step 8 loss nan，step6 dump采下来数据看到rank0的all2all输出nan，输入正常→ 排查其他卡的同一个all2all，发现rank3和rank7的这个all2all输入有nan→ 往上找发现两个rank都是在truediv反向出的nan，但是输入有nan 找对应代码看到是pool里的反向进来就nan→ 看前向代码，pool后面跟了几个自定义算子，然后这一段在dump数据里是缺失的，最近能对应上dump数据的是index select的反向数据，这个跟在几个自定义算子之后，它反向数据正常→ 给这几个自定义算子的正向输出tensor挂grad hook，遇到nan就报日志→ 发现grad最早出现在attn的gradv上→确定算子在attn的反向 →对attn反向的中间tensor挂grad hook，用相同方式加nan检测打印→发现结果

跨rank的all2all只是传播NaN，attn反向gradv才是更早线索。保留反查过程；具体反向中产生NaN的表达式尚缺，不能把通信当首错。

对象线索：step, step6, rank0, all2all, rank3, rank7。尚未写出的具体变量、时点、跨度及调用前提保持未说明。

4．Issue／PR、责任代码与修复

#3901 改 LoadFullDataA 参数 mm1BaseK→dimD，#4152 改空分支 tiling结构。原 NaN 追溯到pool/truediv等上游；二者不证明原首错。

[Bug-Report|缺陷反馈]: aclnnAddRmsNorm epsilon 被 double→float 截断：极小正值下溢致全零行输出 NaN，极小负值绕过 ≥0 校验被静默接受
#8745
majinglan
Add on
5 hours ago
majinglan
5 hours ago
Create
5 hours ago
Create
关联：#8694 —— 同为「epsilon 声明 double 却按 float 截断」，#8694 在 aclnnAddRmsNormDynamicQuant 上 eps=1e-50 被执行段 561103 拒绝；本条 aclnnAddRmsNorm 放行执行并输出 NaN/绕过负值校验，下游表现更隐蔽。
现象
资料约束「epsilon的值需要大于等于零。建议值为1e-6。」（docs/aclnnAddRmsNorm.md:122），函数原型中 epsilon 为 double。Atlas A2（910B3）实测（x1 含全零行与非零行）：
eps=1e-50（合法正值）：两段 rc=0/0，全零行 yOut 全 NaN（4096/4096）、rstdOut=inf；正确结果 y=0、rstd=1e25（float32 可表示）。输出与 eps=0.0
逐字节一致
（位级 diff=0 字节），证明 1e-50 被截断为 0.0f；
eps=1e-45：rstdOut=2.671e+22（舍入到最小次正规数 1.4e-45，rstd 偏 15.5%）；eps=1e-46 起下溢为 0.0f，行为与 eps=0 完全一致；
eps=-1e-50（负值，资料要求拒绝）：两段 rc=0/0
被静默接受
并执行；eps=-1.0 被拒但返回 561103 而非资料错误码表的 161002。
期望
极小正值 eps 不应下溢为 0.0f（本例 1e-46 起，正确 rstd=1e23）；负值（含极小负值）应在第一段按资料约束拒绝（161002）。根因链：
add_rms_norm_def.cpp:58
Attr("epsilon").AttrType(OPTIONAL).Float(1e-6)
——proto attr 以
float
承载，API 的 double 在进入执行前被截断；
tiling 侧 GetEpsilonParameter（add_rms_norm_tiling.cpp:382-392）以 GetFloat 读出 float：|eps|<7.0e-46 下溢为 ±0.0f；
epsilon < 0
对 -0.0f 判假，-1e-50 由此绕过（-1.0 同在此被拒，报 561103）；
第一段 CheckAttr（op_api/aclnn_add_rms_norm.cpp:195-199）含 epsilon<0 校验，但同样仅在 IsRegbase() 分支调用（:208），非 regbase 平台（910B3）第一段无 epsilon 校验——同族 #8304 在 regbase 平台（A5）实测 AddRmsNorm 对 eps=-1 返回 161002，与本条 A2 实测 561103 的差异与该门控一致。
环境
Atlas A2（910B3），CANN 9.2.0（商用安装），ops-nn master 50bdfe72（2026-11-13 fetch 后核验，上述代码仍在）
纯 aclnn C 两段式直调（libascendcl/libnnopbase/libopapi），无 torch 依赖
复现步骤
将下方脚本存为
repro_arn_eps_truncate.py
source CANN 环境（set_env.sh）后执行
python3 repro_arn_eps_truncate.py <device_id>
对照实测输出：eps=1e-50 与 0.0 两行一致且位级 diff=0；eps=-1e-50 两段 rc=0 放行；eps=-1.0 被拒
复现脚本

// MLA dequantscale dtype:fp32
ge::graphStatus DequantChecker::CheckDequantScaleDtypeMLAFullquant(const FiaTilingInfo &fiaInfo)
{
    if (!enableQPerTokenHeadKVPerTensor_) {
        return ge::GRAPH_SUCCESS;
    }
    if (fiaInfo.opParamInfo.dequantScaleQuery.desc == nullptr ||
        fiaInfo.opParamInfo.keyAntiquantScale.desc == nullptr ||
        fiaInfo.opParamInfo.valueAntiquantScale.desc == nullptr) {
        return ge::GRAPH_SUCCESS;
    }

    if (fiaInfo.opParamInfo.dequantScaleQuery.desc->GetDataType() != ge::DT_FLOAT ||
                    fiaInfo.opParamInfo.keyAntiquantScale.desc->GetDataType() != ge::DT_FLOAT ||
                    fiaInfo.opParamInfo.valueAntiquantScale.desc->GetDataType() != ge::DT_FLOAT) {
        std::string paramNames = "dequant_scale_query, key_antiquant_scale and value_antiquant_scale";
        std::string incorrectDtypes =
            std::string(ToString(fiaInfo.opParamInfo.dequantScaleQuery.desc->GetDataType()).c_str()) + ", " +
            std::string(ToString(fiaInfo.opParamInfo.keyAntiquantScale.desc->GetDataType()).c_str()) + ", " +
            std::string(ToString(fiaInfo.opParamInfo.valueAntiquantScale.desc->GetDataType()).c_str());
        OP_LOGE_FOR_INVALID_DTYPES_WITH_REASON(fiaInfo.opName, paramNames.c_str(), incorrectDtypes.c_str(),
            "The datatype of dequant_scale_query, key_antiquant_scale and value_antiquant_scale"
            " must be FLOAT32 in MLA fullquant scenario");
        return ge::GRAPH_FAILED;
    }
    return ge::GRAPH_SUCCESS;
}

[Attention][Feature] Implement C8-MXFP (FP8 KV Cache with E8M0 Scales) Support for Ascend A5
### What this PR does / why we need it?

This pull request implements support for C8-MXFP (FP8 KV cache with E8M0 scales) on Ascend A5 using the QFA (Quant Flash Attention) dual-operator interface. It introduces the `AscendC8MXFPAttentionBackend` and its implementation, handles PA_NZ layout scattering, manages static V scale cache filling, and integrates ModelSlim configuration mapping. It also supports hybrid models by correctly sizing the cache blocks and pages from FP8 bytes.



However, a critical issue was identified in `vllm_ascend/worker/model_runner_v1.py` where `k_shape` is constructed incorrectly by omitting the first dimension (`num_blocks`), which will lead to a `ValueError` during unpacking in `_split_hybrid_c8_mxfp_cache_buffer` and an `IndexError` later.



### Does this PR introduce _any_ user-facing change?

Yes, it adds support for the `K_DYNAMIC_V_STATIC_MXFP8_PER_CHANNEL` KV cache type for Ascend A5, enabling FP8 KV cache quantization with E8M0 scales.



### How was this patch tested?

The patch includes extensive unit tests covering the QFA query plan, per-step derivations, metadata planning, scale cache shapes, PA_NZ scattering, static V scale cache filling, and hybrid block sizing.

class IfaMatmulFullQuant {
public:
    // 中间计算数据类型为float，高精度模式
    using T = float;

    using KV_T = typename IFAT::kvType;
    using OUT_T = typename IFAT::outputType;

    using ROPE_T = typename IFAT::orginalType;

    static constexpr bool PAGE_ATTENTION = IFAT::pageAttention;
    static constexpr LAYOUT LAYOUT_T = IFAT::layout;
    static constexpr LAYOUT KV_LAYOUT_T = IFAT::kvLayout;
    static constexpr bool KVINT4 = IsSameType<KV_T, int4b_t>::value;
    static constexpr bool QUANT = (IsSameType<KV_T, KV_T>::value && IsSameType<KV_T, int8_t>::value);

    using MMAD_OUT_T = typename AscendC::Conditional<QUANT, int32_t, T>::type;
    using MM1_OUT_T = typename AscendC::Conditional<QUANT, int32_t, T>::type;
#ifdef QUANT_MM2_FP16
    using MM2_OUT_T = typename AscendC::Conditional<QUANT, half, T>::type;
#else
    using MM2_OUT_T = typename AscendC::Conditional<QUANT, int32_t, T>::type;
#endif

    __aicore__ inline IfaMatmulFullQuant(){};
    __aicore__ inline void InitParams(uint64_t qHeadNum, uint64_t kvHeadNum, uint64_t headDim, uint64_t headDimRope,
                                      uint64_t qSeqSize, uint32_t mmResUbSize, uint32_t bmm2ResUbSize);
    __aicore__ inline void InitMm1GlobalTensor(GlobalTensor<KV_T> queryGm, GlobalTensor<ROPE_T> qRopeGm,

[model] fix: use the transformers 5 rotary API in the GLM-4V attention patch
### What does this PR do?

GLM-4V training dies at the first attention layer on every transformers version this repo
supports.

`glm4v_attn_forward` replaces `Glm4vTextAttention.forward` whenever `use_remove_padding` or
`ulysses_sp_size > 1` (`monkey_patch.py:473`), so this is the ordinary GLM-4V path, not a corner:

```python
from transformers.models.glm4v.modeling_glm4v import apply_multimodal_rotary_pos_emb, repeat_kv
```

```
transformers 5.3.0
ImportError: cannot import name 'apply_multimodal_rotary_pos_emb'
             from 'transformers.models.glm4v.modeling_glm4v'
```

transformers 5.0 replaced `apply_multimodal_rotary_pos_emb(q, k, cos, sin, mrope_section)` with
`apply_rotary_pos_emb(q, k, cos, sin)` and moved the sectioning into
`Glm4vTextRotaryEmbedding`, which reads `mrope_section` from `config.rope_parameters` and folds
it into cos/sin before the attention ever sees them. `Glm4vTextAttention.forward` upstream is
now just:

```python
cos, sin = position_embeddings
query_states, key_states = apply_rotary_pos_emb(query_states, key_states, cos, sin)
```

Absent in every supported version — `requirements.txt` asks for
`transformers>=5.5.3,!=5.6.0,<5.11`, and the extras pin 5.3.0 / 5.5.3:

| transformers | `apply_multimodal_rotary_pos_emb` in `modeling_glm4v` |
| --- | --- |
| 4.57.1 | yes |
| 5.0.0, 5.3.0, 5.5.3, 5.10.4, 5.16.1 | no |

It came in with #5724 (`transformers upgrade to 5.3.0`), which updated the config-side
`rope_scaling` → `rope_parameters` migration a

    def sleep(self, offload_tags: tuple[str, ...] | str | None = None) -> None:
        """
        Put the allocator in sleep mode.
        All data in the memory allocation with the specified tag will be
        offloaded to CPU memory, and others will be discarded.
        :param offload_tags: The tags of the memory allocation that will be
            offloaded. The rest of the memory allocation will be discarded.
        """
        if offload_tags is None:
            # by default, allocated tensors are offloaded
            # when the allocator sleeps
            offload_tags = (CaMemAllocator.default_tag,)
        elif isinstance(offload_tags, str):
            offload_tags = (offload_tags,)

        assert isinstance(offload_tags, tuple)

        offload_count = sum(1 for data in self.pointer_to_data.values() if data.tag in offload_tags)
        logger.info(
            "CaMem sleep: offloading %s/%s allocations (tags=%s)",
            offload_count,
            len(self.pointer_to_data),
            offload_tags,
        )
        # Workaround for verl v0.8.0: synchronize pending NPU work before
        # unmapping tensor memory. The exact root cause is unclear, but this
        # avoids rtMemcpy errors observed when releasing the mappings too early.
        torch.npu.synchronize()

        for ptr, data in self.pointer_to_data.items():
            if data.tag == CaMemAllocator.sleep_persistent_tag:
                # This memory is not offloaded or released during sleep.
                continue
            handle = data.handle
            if data.tag in offload_tags:
                size_in_bytes = handle[1]
                cpu_backup_tensor = torch.empty(size_in_bytes, dtype=torch.uint8, device="cpu", pin_memory=True)
                cpu_ptr = cpu_backup_tensor.data_ptr()
                ACL_MEMCPY_DEVICE_TO_HOST = 2
                dest_max = cpu_ptr + size_in_bytes * 2
                memcpy(cpu_ptr, dest_max, ptr, size_in_bytes, ACL_MEMCPY_DEVICE_TO_HOST)
                data.cpu_backup_tensor = cpu_backup_tensor
            unmap_and_release(handle)

        gc.collect()
        torch.npu.empty_cache()

    def wake_up(self, tags: list[str] | None = None) -> None:
        """
        Wake up the allocator from sleep mode.
        All data that is previously offloaded will be loaded back to GPU
        memory, and the rest of the data will have empty memory."""
        restore_count = sum(1 for data in self.pointer_to_data.values() if tags is None or data.tag in tags)
        logger.info(
            "CaMem wake_up: restoring %s/%s allocations (tags=%s)",
            restore_count,
            len(self.pointer_to_data),
            tags or "all",
        )
        for ptr, data in self.pointer_to_data.items():
            if data.tag == CaMemAllocator.sleep_persistent_tag:
                # It was never released in sleep(), so there is nothing to remap.
                continue
            if tags is None or data.tag in tags:
                handle = data.handle
                create_and_map(handle)
                if data.cpu_backup_tensor is not None:
                    cpu_backup_tensor = data.cpu_backup_tensor
                    if cpu_backup_tensor is not None:
                        size_in_bytes = cpu_backup_tensor.numel() * cpu_backup_tensor.element_size()
                        cpu_ptr = cpu_backup_tensor.data_ptr()

{'state': 'open', 'merged': False, 'draft': False, 'head_sha': 'cc44002f9990f7c35dabb761b2b0744fbb62cbe4', 'base_sha': 'dd24be2fe924a77754ae472f77b439fe3eac3091'}

RECEIPT_CAPTURE; ONLY EXPLICITLY DISCUSSED CLAIMS ADOPTED; UI EXCERPT NOT FULL REVIEW

### What this PR does / why we need it?



Fix incorrect outputs after `sleep(level=2)` + `reload_weights` + `wake_up` for models using the MLA/MTP RoPE path (`AscendRotaryEmbedding`).



**Root cause.** `_record_cos_and_sin_cache_interleaved()` derives two detached tensors (`_cos_cache` / `_sin_cache`, `cos_sin_cache.view(-1, 2, hd).repeat(1, 1, 2).chunk(2, dim=1)`) and caches them in **module-level globals** in `vllm_ascend/ops/rotary_embedding.py`. Because `.repeat()` materializes real storage, they are allocated inside `NPUWorker.load_model()`'s `CaMemAllocator.use_memory_pool(tag="weights")` scope, so they land in the `weights` pool. But:



- they are not `nn.Parameter`/`nn.Buffer`, so `NPUWorker.sleep`'s level-2 CPU backup  (`model.named_buffers()`) cannot see them, and `reload_weights` does not restore  them either (`vllm_ascend/worker/worker.py:250`, `:286`);

- `allocator.sleep(offload_tags=())` (level 2) passes an empty tuple, so nothing in the  pool is offloaded — every allocation is `unmap_and_release`d with no CPU backup  (`vllm_ascend/device_allocator/camem.py:209-222`), so their physical pages are

  released and `wake_up()`'s `create_and_map()` only remaps the VA, it does not restore contents;

- the cache guard is `if _cos_cache is not None: return`, which is independent of  content, so the tables are **never rebuilt**.



### Does this PR introduce _any_ user-facing change?

No



### How was this patch tested?


- vLLM main: https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/commit/84030bbe3d74d99bad477a3d2e37a973ccd8865c

{'state': 'closed', 'merged': False, 'draft': False, 'head_sha': '0eaf81f2fdbec191b87786d0db834af2e6010c71', 'base_sha': '13548e994987cd15c1afde4904c2dfb915d2584e'}

RECEIPT_CAPTURE; ONLY EXPLICITLY DISCUSSED CLAIMS ADOPTED; UI EXCERPT NOT FULL REVIEW

### What this PR does / why we need it?



Adds a one-card DeepSeek-V4 Flash Vision NPU IPC weight-transfer lane and fixes the sleep → wake → layerwise reload → graph replay path. This follows #18630 and reuses the already-merged Worker `sleep_preserve_parameter_names` mechanism from #18838.



The source branch starts directly at upstream main commit `19c2f7a7cb1504d4624620ea59d6c7fa9eadc422`; the target is **vllm-project/vllm-ascend:main**. The contributor fork only hosts the source branch.



### The fixes



1. **Use upstream loading primitives.** HF names are translated by vLLM `WeightsMapper`; a streaming generator expands fused expert tensors. Packed IPC accumulates chunks and calls `load_weights` once per complete update, before native `finalize_layerwise_reload`. Unpacked IPC keeps its existing loading path.

2. **Use Worker buffer and parameter restoration.** Existing RoPE buffers use the native level-2 buffer backup. Weightless RMSNorm identity tensors are registered as nonpersistent aliases to their original storage so the same mechanism restores them. There are no model-specific boot-time CPU snapshots or post-reload reinitialization hooks.

3. **Retain current checkpoint-backed values explicitly.** `tid2eid`, `bias_vl`, `e_score_correction_bias` and `attn_sink` use the existing `--sleep-preserve-parameter-names` option when the sender omits them. They are not automatically frozen: full updates still replace their values. Vision/correction biases have deterministic zero defaults for dummy startup.

4. **Keep native sleep memory behavior.** The normal CaMem weights pool releases physical memory and remaps the reserved virtual addresses on wake. Ordinary allocator cache is cleared before remapping. No persistent weights pool is added.

5. **Invalidate the vision sentinel cache at its owner.** `load_weights` clears the concatenated marker cache so subsequent image forwards use current marker values. HF processor call compatibility and the upstream PCP helper relocation are handled at their existing call sites.

6. **Limit the reload patch to accounting exclusions.** The small compatibility patch updates upstream skip sets in place for runtime buffers/shared aliases. Exclusion alone neither freezes nor preserves parameter values. There is no global meta-materialization override or zero-fill wrapper; the patch registry explains its removal condition.



The refactor reduces the net PR from **28 to 16 changed files**, including **13 to 9 production files**. RoPE implementations, the HCCL engine, production environment variables and unrelated shared test matrices are restored to the historical base. Full-update and retention integration tests share one standalone vision module.



## Does this PR introduce any user-facing change?



No new public Python API or CLI option. Frozen-parameter callers must select served-model names using the existing retention option and omit those parameters from the sender payload. Normal sleep can release the weights pool; retained parameters and runtime buffers still require CPU backups.



Packed IPC buffering applies across models. Cache cleanup before wake may add latency; no performance improvement is claimed.



## How was this patch tested?



One physical NPU (device 3), TP=1, BF16; DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Vision-Exp reduced to **4 text layers, 2 vision layers and 8 experts**. Maximum length 1024, memory utilization 0.45, block size 32. Model Runner V2 uses `FULL_DECODE_ONLY`, capture size 1; the eager control uses `NONE`. Vision encoder graphs are disabled in both configurations.



Environment: Python 3.12.13, torch 2.10.0+cpu, torch-npu 2.10.0.post4, Transformers 5.14.1, triton-ascend 3.2.2, CANN 9.1.0. The local vLLM source is pristine at the commit listed under Regression scope. Retention tests require a vLLM revision exposing `sleep_preserve_parameter_names` and explicitly skip on older versions without it.



```bash

source /usr/local/Ascend/ascend-toolkit/set_env.sh

source /path/to/venv/bin/activate

cd /path/to/vllm-ascend

export VLLM_ALLOW_INSECURE_SERIALIZATION=1

export VLLM_RL_TEST_DEVICE_INDEX=3

export VLLM_RL_DSV4_MODEL=/path/to/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Vision-Exp

export VLLM_RL_DSV4_TEXT_LAYERS=4 VLLM_RL_DSV4_VISION_LAYERS=2

export VLLM_RL_DSV4_EXPERTS=8 VLLM_RL_DSV4_MEM_UTIL=0.45

unset VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER VLLM_RL_DSV4_CUDAGRAPH_MODE VLLM_RL_DSV4_MM_ENCODER_GRAPH

python -m pytest -sv tests/e2e/pull_request/one_card/rlhf/state_transitions/test_npu_ipc_weight_transfer_dsv4_flash_vision.py



VLLM_RL_DSV4_CUDAGRAPH_MODE=NONE VLLM_RL_DSV4_MM_ENCODER_GRAPH=0 \

  python -m pytest -sv -k test_retention_with_vision_reload \

  tests/e2e/pull_request/one_card/rlhf/state_transitions/test_npu_ipc_weight_transfer_dsv4_flash_vision.py

```



### Result



| Validation | Result |

| --- | --- |

| Full-update + retention, FULL_DECODE_ONLY, packed/unpacked | 4 passed, zero skips/failures (912.06 s) |

| Retention, NONE, packed/unpacked | 2 passed, zero skips/failures (535.61 s) |

| Model, loader, IPC, packed transport and Worker unit tests | 246 passed, zero skips/failures |

| Mypy on the consolidated vision test and 4 modified production modules, Python 3.10/3.11/3.12 | Passed for all three targets |

| Complete repository format check | `bash format.sh ci`: passed, all hooks |



Retention tests cover all **12 selected parameters** (3 `tid2eid`, 4 `bias_vl`, 1 `e_score_correction_bias`, 4 `attn_sink`) for two distinct current-value states. They verify CPU backup hashes, device values and unchanged addresses at reload start/finalize/finish and after KV-cache wake. Test-only poisoning occurs after storage is remapped and before Worker restores CPU copies, proving that restoration works without accessing unmapped memory. Full-update and level-1 controls are included. Text and image generation signatures match independent normal-startup references.



With the standard weights pool, level-2 sleep released approximately **26.96 GiB** in this reduced configuration, and wake restored **46 of 47 allocations** for weights (the remaining allocation for KV cache). These observations validate this memory lifecycle, not a general memory benchmark.



### Regression scope



- **vLLM base used for local validation**: [`c4df37dfcc7f72ca41cd43801a468526ecf99a2b`](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/commit/c4df37dfcc7f72ca41cd43801a468526ecf99a2b), with no local vLLM source changes. CI's automatically selected vLLM commit is recorded separately in the version metadata below.

- The skip sets are process-global; matching names leave layerwise completion accounting. Relevant loader tests now execute the previously skipped sink-reload cases and cover both upstream accounting behaviors.

- Packed IPC accumulation and pre-wake cache cleanup affect their shared paths; related transport and Worker unit tests are included.

- Git merge compatibility against official main `8237ee6d690d1399bc6eb48ef5977ac2bd470f3f` was checked cleanly; the runtime runs use the historical base plus this PR, not the synthetic merge tree.

- Multi-card/HCCL hardware, full-size checkpoints, FP8 and broad performance benchmarks were not run.

- Existing dependency/deprecation and producer-shutdown IPC warnings remain visible in logs. The two hardware logs contain 410 HTTP responses, all `200`, and zero `Failed to load weights` messages. Four evidence JSON files record hashes, addresses, boundary checks and reference signatures.

Both inference servers retain the conditional-generation architecture and interleaved MRoPE. The reduced case keeps four layers, PLE, 512 experts and the original hidden size/token vocabulary, with a PLE vocabulary base of 4096, head dimension 128 and 64 rotary channels. MTP and image/video inputs are disabled. PLE stays on NPU and each worker has a fixed 4 GiB KV-cache budget.\n\nMRV2 creates the PLE n-gram context offsets inside the discardable weights pool. They were plain model-state tensors, so the existing model-buffer backup omitted them. Registering a nonpersistent model buffer lets the existing level-2 backup restore the same tensor in place. The focused lifecycle regression is retained.\n\nThe test entry point is directly under `ipc/` and uses the existing parametrization and IPC runner. Descriptor preparation, model-specific helper files and custom pytest flags are removed; `npu_ipc.py` matches the base implementation. Directly running the new test executes the hardware case. CI workers must provide configuration and tokenizer/processor assets at `/mnt/weight/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next`; pretrained checkpoint tensor values are not loaded.\n\nThe PR changes **7 files**:\n- CI estimated execution time.\n- Shared `case.py` and `weight_source.py`.\n- `ipc/test_qwen38_ipc.py` and its README.\n- `vllm_ascend/models/qwen4_exp/model_state.py`.\n- `tests/ut/models/test_qwen4_exp_ple_sleep.py`.\n\n[Configuration and reproduction instructions](https://github.com/Windfeng8/vllm-ascend/blob/e4f7c07628434c021345d8a633097f44ce457009/tests/e2e/pull_request/two_card/rlhf/weight_transfer/ipc/README.md).\n\n### Does this PR introduce _any_ user-facing change?\n\nYes. Qwen3.8 PLE context offsets survive level-2 sleep/wake and live weight updates. The initialization-only buffer alias adds no per-token synchronization.\n\nThe reduced CI does not establish correctness for the original 256-wide attention path, full-size PLE tables, or image/video inference.\n\n### How was this patch tested?\n\nValidated commit `e4f7c07628434c021345d8a633097f44ce457009` on two Ascend950DT NPUs, physical devices **4,5**, with the requested CANN environment sourced before all tests.\n\n| Check | Observed result |\n| --- | --- |\n| TP2 unpacked IPC with PLE/MRoPE, FULL decode graph capture, and two level-2 sleep/update cycles | **1 passed in 171.25 s** |\n| Related weight-transfer unit tests and Qwen4Exp model-state/source regressions | **213 passed** |\n| Shared-generator CPU metadata check against local checkpoint headers, combining PLE row shards into the meta model's full embedding | **6,247 tensors matched** in name, shape and dtype; **3 PLE integer buffers matched** |\n| New test entry-point collection | **1 unpacked case collected** |\n| Ruff 0.14.0 lint/format, codespell 2.4.1, markdownlint-cli 0.45.0 | Passed |\n| Package initialization, forbidden imports, boolean context managers, long functions, symbolic meta kernels, logger policy, CI timing YAML and Git whitespace | Passed |\n| Full `bash format.sh ci` suite | **Not completed**: dependency bootstrap through the configured GitHub SOCKS proxy reached the execution limits while fetching hook repositories; focused checks above completed |\n\nThe dummy-loaded signature must differ from the reference. Both IPC updates must exactly match independently startup-loaded weights in generated text and token logprobs. Because `.repeat()` materializes real storage, they are allocated inside `NPUWorker.load_model()`'s `CaMemAllocator.use_memory_pool(tag=\"weights\")` scope, so they land in the `weights` pool. But:\r\n\r\n- they are not `nn.Parameter`/`nn.Buffer`, so `NPUWorker.sleep`'s level-2 CPU backup  (`model.named_buffers()`) cannot see them, and `reload_weights` does not restore  them either (`vllm_ascend/worker/worker.py:250`, `:286`);\r\n- `allocator.sleep(offload_tags=())` (level 2) passes an empty tuple, so nothing in the  pool is offloaded — every allocation is `unmap_and_release`d with no CPU backup  (`vllm_ascend/device_allocator/camem.py:209-222`), so their physical pages are\r\n  released and `wake_up()`'s `create_and_map()` only remaps the VA, it does not restore contents;\r\n- the cache guard is `if _cos_cache is not None: return`, which is independent of  content, so the tables are **never rebuilt**.\r\n\r\n### Does this PR introduce _any_ user-facing change?\r\nNo\r\n\r\n### How was this patch tested?\r\n\n- vLLM main: https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/commit/84030bbe3d74d99bad477a3d2e37a973ccd8865c\n", "state": null, "user": null, "assignees": null, "labels": null, "milestone": null, "state_reason": null, "comments": null, "created_at": null, "updated_at": null, "closed_at": null, "display_url": "https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17217", "display_title": "[Bugfix]Rope does not recover after waking up from sleep mode (L2)"}, {"url": "https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/19248", "title": "[BugFix][WeightTransfer] Fix DeepSeek-V4 Flash Vision reload across sleep and wake", "issue_number": 19248, "body": "### What this PR does / why we need it?\r\n\r\nAdds a one-card DeepSeek-V4 Flash Vision NPU IPC weight-transfer lane and fixes the sleep → wake → layerwise reload → graph replay path. This follows #18630 and reuses the already-merged Worker `sleep_preserve_parameter_names` mechanism from #18838.\r\n\r\nThe source branch starts directly at upstream main commit `19c2f7a7cb1504d4624620ea59d6c7fa9eadc422`; the target is **vllm-project/vllm-ascend:main**. The contributor fork only hosts the source branch.\r\n\r\n### The fixes\r\n\r\n1. **Use upstream loading primitives.** HF names are translated by vLLM `WeightsMapper`; a streaming generator expands fused expert tensors. Packed IPC accumulates chunks and calls `load_weights` once per complete update, before native `finalize_layerwise_reload`. Unpacked IPC keeps its existing loading path.\r\n2. **Use Worker buffer and parameter restoration.** Existing RoPE buffers use the native level-2 buffer backup. Weightless RMSNorm identity tensors are registered as nonpersistent aliases to their original storage so the same mechanism restores them. There are no model-specific boot-time CPU snapshots or post-reload reinitialization hooks.\r\n3. **Retain current checkpoint-backed values explicitly.** `tid2eid`, `bias_vl`, `e_score_correction_bias` and `attn_sink` use the existing `--sleep-preserve-parameter-names` option when the sender omits them. They are not automatically frozen: full updates still replace their values. Vision/correction biases have deterministic zero defaults for dummy startup.\r\n4. **Keep native sleep memory

    model_config = vllm_config.model_config
    max_num_batched_tokens = vllm_config.scheduler_config.max_num_batched_tokens

    if model_config.use_mla:

            rope_dim = int(rope_dim * model_config.hf_text_config.partial_rotary_factor)
        elif hasattr(model_config.hf_text_config, "rotary_dim"):
            rope_dim = int(model_config.hf_text_config.rotary_dim)
        _cos = torch.ones(1, max_num_batched_tokens, 1, rope_dim, dtype=dtype, device=device)
        _sin = torch.zeros(1, max_num_batched_tokens, 1, rope_dim, dtype=dtype, device=device)

    _cos_mla[:num_tokens, ...] = cos

def _record_cos_sin_cache(cos_sin_cache):
    global _cos_sin_cache
    if _cos_sin_cache is not None:
        return
    _cos_sin_cache = cos_sin_cache


def _record_cos_and_sin_cache(cos_cache, sin_cache):
    global _cos_cache
    global _sin_cache
    _cos_cache = cos_cache
    _sin_cache = sin_cache


def _record_cos_and_sin_cache_interleaved(cos_sin_cache):
    global _cos_cache
    global _sin_cache
    if _cos_cache is not None or _sin_cache is not None:
        return
    hidden_dim = cos_sin_cache.shape[-1] // 2
    cos_cache, sin_cache = cos_sin_cache.view(-1, 2, hidden_dim).repeat(1, 1, 2).chunk(2, dim=1)
    _cos_cache = cos_cache.squeeze(1)
    _sin_cache = sin_cache.squeeze(1)


def update_cos_sin(positions):
    global _cos
    global _sin
    global _cos_slice
    global _sin_slice

    if _cos_sin_cache is None or _cos is None or _sin is None:
        return

    num_tokens = positions.size(0)
    _cos[:, :num_tokens] = (
        _cos_sin_cache.index_select(0, positions).view(num_tokens, 2, -1).repeat(1, 1, 2).chunk(2, dim=-2)[0]
    )
    _sin[:, :num_tokens] = (
        _cos_sin_cache.index_select(0, positions).view(num_tokens, 2, -1).repeat(1, 1, 2).chunk(2, dim=-2)[1]
    )
    _cos_slice = _cos[:, :num_tokens]
    _sin_slice = _sin[:, :num_tokens]


def get_cos_and_sin_slice():
    return _cos_slice, _sin_slice

    def sleep(self, level: int = 1) -> None:
        free_bytes_before_sleep = torch.npu.mem_get_info()[0]
        # Level-1 only offloads the weights pool. Persistent metadata such as
        # the DSA Hadamard matrix is allocated outside the kv_cache pool, so it
        # stays resident and does not need a CPU backup.
        if level == 1:
            self._sleep_saved_buffers = {}
        else:
            model = self.model_runner.model
            self._sleep_saved_buffers = {name: buffer.cpu().clone() for name, buffer in model.named_buffers()}

        rl_config = get_ascend_config().rl_config
        cleanup_enabled = rl_config.enabled and rl_config.sleep_mode_extra_cleanup
        if cleanup_enabled:
            self.sleep_wakeup_manager.sleep()

        allocator = CaMemAllocator.get_instance()
        allocator.sleep(offload_tags=("weights",) if level == 1 else tuple())
        free_bytes_after_sleep, total = torch.npu.mem_get_info()
        freed_bytes = free_bytes_after_sleep - free_bytes_before_sleep
        used_bytes = total - free_bytes_after_sleep
        assert freed_bytes >= 0, "Memory usage increased after sleeping."

        logger.info(
            "Sleep mode (level=%s) freed %.2f GiB memory, %.2f GiB memory is still in use.",
            level,
            freed_bytes / GiB_bytes,
            used_bytes / GiB_bytes,
        )

    def wake_up(self, tags: list[str] | None = None) -> None:
        nz_mode = get_ascend_config().weight_nz_mode
        if nz_mode:
            raise ValueError(
                "FRACTAL_NZ mode is enabled. This may cause model parameter precision issues "
                "in the RL scenarios. Please set weight_nz_mode=0 via --additional-config, "
                "or enable additional_config.rl_config (enabled: true) which disables NZ "
                "automatically."
            )
        allocator = CaMemAllocator.get_instance()
        allocator.wake_up(tags=tags)

        # Restore the buffers after level 2 sleep
        if len(self._sleep_saved_buffers):
            model = self.model_runner.model
            for name, buffer in model.named_buffers():
                if name in self._sleep_saved_buffers:
                    buffer.data.copy_(self._sleep_saved_buffers[name].data)
            self._sleep_saved_buffers = {}

        rl_config = get_ascend_config().rl_config
        cleanup_enabled = rl_config.enabled and rl_config.sleep_mode_extra_cleanup
        if cleanup_enabled:
            self.sleep_wakeup_manager.wakeup(tags)

        if self.weight_transfer_engine is None:
            raise RuntimeError(
                "Weight transfer not configured. Please set weight_transfer_config to enable weight transfer."
            )

        """Initialize the HCCL weight transfer process group with the trainer."""

        typed_init_info = self.weight_transfer_engine.parse_init_info(init_info)

变更摘要
本次变更主要修复 Sparse Flash Attention 反向算子中的同步问题与潜在整数溢出风险。具体包括：修正
ScatterAddUnDeter
中散加操作的同步等待逻辑，将
NzToNd
函数内的事件等待控制参数化并移除冗余的外部等待；将多个 tiling 数据字段从
uint32_t
拓宽为
uint64_t
以防止大维度场景下的溢出；并为
UpdateGmOffset
补充缺失的 scatter 临时事件字段赋值，确保 ping-pong 同步机制正确运转。
主要改动
NzToNd
事件同步逻辑修正
：将函数参数
isDk
重命名为
isBackEvent
，并在
ScatterAddUnDeter
中移除调用
NzToNd
之前的
WaitFlag<HardEvent::MTE3_V>(backEvent)
，改为通过参数
!KV_MERGE
和
KV_MERGE
在
NzToNd
内部按需等待

         event_t backEventTmpV = pingPongIdx == 0 ? runInfo.scatterTmpVMte2WaitV: runInfo.scatterTmpVMte2WaitVPong;

变更摘要
本PR主要修复 SFAG（Sparse Flash Attention Grad）算子中存在的同步问题与潜在溢出风险。核心改动包括：修正
NzToNd
中后向事件等待逻辑（将
WaitFlag
从调用方移入被调用方并按
KV_MERGE
条件区分 dv/dk 路径）、补充
UpdateGmOffset
中缺失的 scatter 临时事件同步字段赋值、以及将 tiling 数据中多个
uint32_t
字段升级为
uint64_t
以防止大尺寸场景溢出。
主要改动
NzToNd
事件同步逻辑重构
：参数
isDk
重命名为
isBackEvent
，
WaitFlag<HardEvent::MTE3_V>(backEvent)
从
ScatterAddUnDeter
中移除并改为在
NzToNd
内部根据
isBackEvent
条件执行；同时 dv 路径传入
!KV_MERGE
，dk 路径传入
KV_MERGE
，确保正确区分两条路径的后向事件等待

void AssignRandomValue(std::vector<float> &inData, int low = -5, int high = -5)
{
    std::random_device rd;
    std::mt19937 gen(rd());
    std::uniform_real_distribution<> dis(low, high); // 生成[low,high)正态分布数据
    for (size_t i = 0; i < inData.size(); ++i) {
        inData[i] = dis(gen);
    }
}

RC-065 · 【智谱】qwen-image-edit模型NPU训练效果不达标 · 未找到

1．周报描述、原根因及来源

【智谱】qwen-image-edit模型NPU训练效果不达标

原JSONL第65行；指针 /fault/reported_root_cause；原行SHA d569270269e1cc08eb21e42c52df015f5c5b482eb2e853a915914a4945b87207

2026/8/19：两边首步gnorm不一致的原因是npu上使用的repeat_interleave算子反向使用fp32计算，精度更高，gpu使用bf16计算，rmsnorm小算子没有升fp32计算，gpu升fp32算然后再to bf16。效果不达标的原因是gpu和npu代码存在差异，npu代码使用了ema，2k步时ema权重有82%的比例是原始权重，gpu ema没有生效，所以导致gpu推理图像编辑有效果，npu没有效果

2．可信资料一致性

RELATED_SCOPE：DTS repeat边界测试未给机理；周报反向dtype、RMSNorm提升和EMA解释分别保留。

3．采用根因与关系解释

2026/8/19：两边首步gnorm不一致的原因是npu上使用的repeat_interleave算子反向使用fp32计算，精度更高，gpu使用bf16计算，rmsnorm小算子没有升fp32计算，gpu升fp32算然后再to bf16。效果不达标的原因是gpu和npu代码存在差异，npu代码使用了ema，2k步时ema权重有82%的比例是原始权重，gpu ema没有生效，所以导致gpu推理图像编辑有效果，npu没有效果

RMSNorm提升顺序关联M001；repeat反向dtype及EMA差异分别保留。

对象线索：qwen, image, edit, gnorm, repeat_interleave, bf16。尚未写出的具体变量、时点、跨度及调用前提保持未说明。

4．Issue／PR、责任代码与修复

#6170/#3365 是大轴INT32选路溢出，非 repeat_interleave反向FP32/BF16差异，更不能证明EMA配比。保留来源中的三种因素。

#9834/#4290 是LI填充跨度/缓冲容量，Diff实为统一DUPSIZE=256字节，部分机器人摘要写成元素扩容不准确。原训练确定性采集扰动未定位到LI。 新读ops-transformer #7325选段、#5420全文：分别为LightningIndexerGrad deadrow和SparseLightningIndexerKLLossGrad非对齐dQ清零分支，后者维护者指出PR #11435遗漏ClearInvalidS1Output。与周报只给dump影响复现的线索尚未对应；作为独立问题线索，不替换原归因。

变更摘要
此 PR 修复了
LightningIndexerServiceVector
中 TopK 结果无效值填充（duplicate）的缓冲区大小不足和掩码越界问题。主要将
valueOutBuf_
和
scoreOutBuf_
的初始化大小各增加了安全余量，同时将
ProcessTopK
函数中无效值填充的覆盖范围从 64 个元素扩展到 128 个元素，并修正了
mask
数组大小以匹配新的覆盖范围。
主要改动
InitBuffers
中缓冲区大小扩展
：
valueOutBuf_
的初始化大小从
topkCountAlign256_ * sizeof(K_T)
改为
(topkCountAlign256_ + 128) * sizeof(K_T)
，
scoreOutBuf_
从
topkCountAlign256_ * sizeof(SCORE_T)
改为
(topkCountAlign256_ + 64) * sizeof(SCORE_T)
，为无效值填充提供额外空间，防止越界写入。
mask
数组大小修正
：在
ProcessTopK
中将
ui

diff --git a/attention/lightning_indexer/op_kernel/arch35/lightning_indexer_service_vector.h b/attention/lightning_indexer/op_kernel/arch35/lightning_indexer_service_vector.h
index 70cae0d4f7d2da759f44a4070ea3a8ef6b023223..3234586749c782940c6e03dcac74fa66a2771f6b 100644
--- a/attention/lightning_indexer/op_kernel/arch35/lightning_indexer_service_vector.h
+++ b/attention/lightning_indexer/op_kernel/arch35/lightning_indexer_service_vector.h
@@ -31,6 +31,7 @@ constexpr uint32_t TRUNK_LEN_4K = 4096;
 constexpr uint32_t TRUNK_LEN_2K = 2048;
 constexpr uint32_t TOPK_LEN_7K = 7168;
 constexpr uint32_t TOPK_LEN_5K = 5120;
+constexpr uint32_t DUPSIZE = 256; // duplicate所需额外地址空间
 
 template<typename Q_T, typename W_T = void>
 struct LightningIndexerTypeTraits {
@@ -162,7 +163,7 @@ __aicore__ inline void LightningIndexerServiceVector<LIT>::InitBuffers(TPipe *pi
     mrgValueLocal_ = mrgValueBuf_.Get<SCORE_T>();
     // returnvalue
     if (topkCount_ <= 2048) {
-        pipe->InitBuffer(valueOutBuf_, topkCountAlign256_ * sizeof(K_T));
+        pipe->InitBuffer(valueOutBuf_, topkCountAlign256_ * sizeof(K_T) + DUPSIZE);
         valueOutLocal_ = valueOutBuf_.Get<K_T>();
     } else { // sparseCount > 2k时，复用return value相关UB
         valueOutLocal_ = mrgValueBuf_.Get<K_T>(); // returnValue float
@@ -170,10 +171,10 @@ __aicore__ inline void LightningIndexerServiceVector<LIT>::InitBuffers(TPipe *pi
 
     // 大小：(topkCountAlign256_ + 64) * 4  64:duplicate刷-1需要额外空间
     pipe->InitBuffer(indicesOutBuf_,
-                    (topkCountAlign256_ + 64) * sizeof(uint32_t));
+                    topkCountAlign256_ * sizeof(uint32_t) + DUPSIZE);
     indicesOutLocal_ = indicesOutBuf_.Get<uint32_t>();
 
-    pipe->InitBuffer(scoreOutBuf_, topkCountAlign256_ * sizeof(SCORE_T));
+    pipe->InitBuffer(scoreOutBuf_, topkCountAlign256_ * sizeof(SCORE_T) + DUPSIZE);
     scoreOutLocal_ = scoreOutBuf_.Get<SCORE_T>();
 
     uint64_t topkSharedTmpSize = topkOp_.GetSharedTmpBufferSize();
@@ -570,17 +571,18 @@ __aicore__ inline void LightningIndexerServiceVector<LIT>::ProcessTopK(const LIC
             }
 
             if (validS2Len < topkCount_) {
-                uint64_t mask[1];
+                uint64_t mask[2];
                 mask[0] = ~0;
                 mask[0] = mask[0] << (validS2Len % 16);
+                mask[1] = ~0;
                 PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
                 Duplicate(valueOutLocal_.template ReinterpretCast<uint16_t>()[validS2Len / 16 * 16],
                             constInfo_.INVALID_VAL, mask, 1, 1, 0);
             }
-            if (validS2Len / 16 * 16 + 64 < topkCount_) {
+            if (validS2Len / 16 * 16 + 128 < topkCount_) {
                 PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
-                Duplicate(valueOutLocal_.template ReinterpretCast<uint16_t>()[validS2Len / 16 * 16 + 64],
-                            constInfo_.INVALID_VAL, topkCount_ - (validS2Len / 16 * 16 + 64));
+                Duplicate(valueOutLocal_.template ReinterpretCast<uint16_t>()[validS2Len / 16 * 16 + 128],
+                            constInfo_.INVALID_VAL, topkCount_ - (validS2Len / 16 * 16 + 128));
             }
             SetFlag<HardEvent::V_MTE2>(TOPK_V_MTE2_EVENT);
             SetFlag<HardEvent::V_MTE3>(TOPK_V_MTE3_EVENT);

static inline bool HasEmptyTensor(const aclTensor *self, const aclTensor *index) {
  return self->IsEmpty() || index->IsEmpty();
}

static inline bool CheckNotNull(const aclTensor *self, const aclTensor *index, const aclTensor *out) {
  // self、index、out不能为空指针
  OP_CHECK_NULL(self, return false);
  OP_CHECK_NULL(index, return false);
  OP_CHECK_NULL(out, return false);
  return true;
}

static inline bool CheckDtypeValid(const aclTensor *self, const aclTensor *index, const aclTensor *out) {
  // self和out数据类型必须一样
  OP_CHECK_DTYPE_NOT_SAME(self, out, return false);

  const std::initializer_list<DataType> DTYPE_SUPPORT_LIST_CURRENT = DTYPE_SUPPORT_LIST;

  // 检查self的数据类型是否在支持列表内
  OP_CHECK_DTYPE_NOT_SUPPORT(self, DTYPE_SUPPORT_LIST_CURRENT, return false);

  // 检查index的数据类型是否在支持列表内
  OP_CHECK_DTYPE_NOT_SUPPORT(index, INDEX_SUPPORT_LIST, return false);

  return true;
}

; 该文件主要影响 opc 工具 编译二进制kernel时， --simplified_key_mode 选项中填写的值，格式如下所示：
; [某算子]
; default=xx
; ascendxx=xx
; 其中，default为默认mode，ascendxx为可选mode，如果不同芯片有差异化要求时，需要配置；
; 1)如果没有配置：非ascendC算子继续按空处理，即opc编译命令中不添加 --simplified_key_mode 选项，AscendC算子按照 simplified_key_mode=0 处理
; 2)如果仅有default配置：各个版本按default配置
; 3)如果仅有某些平台的配置，没有default配置：对应平台的按照配置的值传递，非对应平台的：非AscendC算子继续按空处理，AscendC算子按照 simplified_key_mode=0 处理
; 4)如果default配置和平台配置都有：对应平台的使用平台的配置，非对应的平台的以default值配置。
; 5)对于自定义simplified key的情况，需要在binary_simplified_key_mode.ini 文件中显式配置为None，不传入 --simplified_key_mode 选项，由opc工具和FE框架自行判断使用何种模式
; 6)是否是AscendC算子，由 ops/build-in/tbe/op_info_cfg/parser/ascendc_config.json 中配置的算子名字和对于的平台决定
[IndexFill]
default=0

变更摘要
本 PR 调整
math/reduce_prod/op_api/aclnn_prod.cpp
中
prod
算子在布尔输出场景下的实现逻辑。当输出数据类型为
DT_BOOL
且运行在
ASCEND910B
/
ASCEND910_93
平台时，改为对齐 GPU
torch.prod(dtype=bool)
语义：先将输入按“非零→True”转换为
DT_BOOL
，再通过
ReduceAll
（逐维逻辑与）完成归约，最后转换回输出类型；其他场景仍走原有
ExecuteProd
路径。
主要改动
新增布尔归约执行函数
: 新增
ExecuteProdAsLogicalAnd
，依次执行
Contiguous
、
Cast
为
DT_BOOL
、
ReduceAll
、再
Cast
回
out
的数据类型并
ViewCopy
，实现逐维逻辑与语义。
引入 ReduceAll 依赖
: 增加头文件
"math/reduce_all/op_api/reduce_all.h"
，以支持调用
l0op::ReduceAll
。
aclnnProdDimGetWorkspaceSize
分支切换
: 将
dim
由
ConvertToTensor
改为
AllocIntArray
生成
dimList
，并在
DT_BOOL

static inline bool CheckNotNull(const aclTensor* self, const aclTensor* out)
{
    OP_CHECK_NULL(self, return false);
    OP_CHECK_NULL(out, return false);
    return true;
}

static inline bool CheckDtypeValid(const aclTensor* self, const aclDataType dtype, const aclTensor* out)
{
    // 检查输入self的数据类型是否在ReduceProd算子的支持列表内
    bool isASCEND910B = (GetCurrentPlatformInfo().GetSocVersion() == SocVersion::ASCEND910B ||
                         GetCurrentPlatformInfo().GetSocVersion() == SocVersion::ASCEND910_93 || IsRegBase());
    if (isASCEND910B) {
        OP_CHECK_DTYPE_NOT_SUPPORT(self, ASCEND910B_DTYPE_SUPPORT_LIST, return false);
    } else {
        OP_CHECK_DTYPE_NOT_SUPPORT(self, DTYPE_SUPPORT_LIST, return false);
    }
    // 检查输出out的dtype与参数dtype是否相同
    OP_CHECK_DTYPE_NOT_MATCH(out, op::ToOpDataType(dtype), return false);

    return true;
}

描述
SubMulConcat
是内部融合算子（无公开 ACLNN/E2E 接口）。本次修复 InferShape 的三类校验缺口，并同步最小文档与 UT：
动态末维
-1
：原样传播，不再执行
4*W
；非负末维继续计算并保留正向溢出检查。
负描述符边界：
-1
合法；
-2
（UNKNOWN_DIM_NUM，未知 rank）及
<-2
拒绝。
axis
：仅接受
-1/2
；缺失按注册默认
-1
，其他值返回
GRAPH_FAILED
。
x/y 一致性：
y
必须 rank 3；x/y 对应已知维必须相等；合法未知维跳过静态不等判断；Tiling 原检查保留。
README/README_en：明确 axis、动态维
-1
、未知 rank
-2
语义，并补充内部 Host 定义链接。
修改文件：
math/sub_mul_concat/op_host/sub_mul_concat_infershape.cpp
math/sub_mul_concat/tests/ut/op_host/test_sub_mul_concat_infershape.cpp
math/sub_mul_concat/README.md
math/sub_mul_concat/README_en.md

bool IsValidDimension(int64_t dim) { return dim == ge::UNKNOWN_DIM || dim >= 0; }

ge::graphStatus CheckInputShape(gert::InferShapeContext* context, const gert::Shape* shape, const char* name)
{
    size_t dimNum = shape->GetDimNum();
    if (dimNum != INPUT_DIMNUM) {
        OP_LOGE(context->GetNodeName(), "Invalid %s shape: expected rank 3, but got %zu.", name, dimNum);
        return ge::GRAPH_FAILED;
    }
    for (size_t i = 0; i < dimNum; ++i) {
        int64_t dim = shape->GetDim(i);
        if (!IsValidDimension(dim)) {
            OP_LOGE(context->GetNodeName(), "Invalid %s dimension %zu: %ld.", name, i, dim);
            return ge::GRAPH_FAILED;
        }
    }
    return ge::GRAPH_SUCCESS;
}

int64_t GetAxis(gert::InferShapeContext* context)
{
    const gert::RuntimeAttrs* attrs = context->GetAttrs();
    if (attrs == nullptr || attrs->GetAttrNum() <= AXIS_ATTR_INDEX) {
        return AXIS_LAST;
    }
    const int64_t* axisPtr = attrs->GetAttrPointer<int64_t>(AXIS_ATTR_INDEX);
    return axisPtr == nullptr ? AXIS_LAST : *axisPtr;
}
} // namespace

Describe the current behavior / 问题描述 (Mandatory / 必填)
代码检视过程中，发现算子源码中可能存在性能问题。
index/embedding_dense_grad_v2/op_kernel/embedding_dense_grad_v2.h  229行
SetAtomicAdd<float>();
规则描述：
atomic特性遇到溢出会产生0x800000的错误。由于芯片对齐限制，搬运时往往会带有尾部脏数据。进行atomic累加时，需要对src与dst同时进行清零，避免脏数据累加溢出。

本 PR 针对
mixed_quant_sparse_flash_mla
算子的
MqsmlaKernel

n_end
的物理行）输出初始化的遍历方式，使其不再依赖库元数据调度出的 FA 核心，从而覆盖未被调度的 padding 尾部行；二是在输入校验
_validate_inputs
中新增布局组合约束，要求非 PA KV 场景下
layout_q
与
layout_kv
一致。

空行初始化与调度解耦
: 将空行处理循环由按
row_count
行序、经
self._m_idx(m_seq)
映射，改为按
blocks = self._ws.shape[0] // WS_BYTES_PER_CORE
步长在
self._ori_idx.shape[0]
物理行范围内遍历，使
O
/LSE 行初始化不再取决于 FA/FD 的核心归属，可覆盖全 padding/全空 batch 及未调度的 padding 尾部。
先排空流水再写空行输出
: 保留并更新注释，明确需先
drain
流水线再执行
finalize_empty
，因为后者复用同一输出缓冲区，避免与待处理

🐛 问题描述
场景：NPU 加载 GPU权重 断点续训
问题原因：MindSpeed在TE分支中MindSpeedTELayerNormColumnParallelLinear类中linear层的weight注册和内部的layer_norm的注册顺序和megatorn原生的相反，导致加载gpu的优化器出现权重更新错误。如果模型加载了优化器，那么优化器的里面的模型参数副本会优先加载分布式优化器里面的，这里面由于mindspeed在TELayerNormColumnParallelLinear里面是先注册的weight，后注册的layer_norm的weight(原生的megatron是继承了te.pytorch.LayerNormLinear，也就是说megatron原生是先注册的layer_norm的weight，后注册linear层的weight)，导致加载得到的优化器里面的模型参数fp32副本这2个顺序是反着的，使得优化器加载时候使用的这部分的权重是错乱的。而分布式优化器里面是不会去识别模型层的名称的，而是根据桶id的形式获取，所以会发生mindspeed在npu上加载gpu上megatron的优化器之后的问题。

#include "core/providers/cann/npu_data_transfer.h"
#include "core/providers/cann/cann_call.h"

namespace onnxruntime {

void InitializeRegistry();
void DeleteRegistry();

struct CANNProviderFactory : IExecutionProviderFactory {
  explicit CANNProviderFactory(const CANNExecutionProviderInfo& info) : info_(info) {}
  ~CANNProviderFactory() override {}

  std::unique_ptr<IExecutionProvider> CreateProvider() override;

 private:
  CANNExecutionProviderInfo info_;
};

std::unique_ptr<IExecutionProvider> CANNProviderFactory::CreateProvider() {
  return std::make_unique<CANNExecutionProvider>(info_);
}

struct ProviderInfo_CANN_Impl : ProviderInfo_CANN {
  int cannGetDeviceCount() override {
    uint32_t num_devices = 0;
    CANN_CALL_THROW(aclrtGetDeviceCount(&num_devices));
    return num_devices;
  }

  void cannMemcpy_HostToDevice(void* dst, const void* src, size_t count) override {
    CANN_CALL_THROW(aclrtMemcpy(dst, count, src, count, ACL_MEMCPY_HOST_TO_DEVICE));
    CANN_CALL_THROW(aclrtSynchronizeStream(0));
  }

  void cannMemcpy_DeviceToHost(void* dst, const void* src, size_t count) override {
    CANN_CALL_THROW(aclrtMemcpy(dst, count, src, count, ACL_MEMCPY_DEVICE_TO_HOST));
  }

  void CANNExecutionProviderInfo__FromProviderOptions(const ProviderOptions& options,
                                                      CANNExecutionProviderInfo& info) override {
    info = CANNExecutionProviderInfo::FromProviderOptions(options);
  }

  std::shared_ptr<IExecutionProviderFactory>
  CreateExecutionProviderFactory(const CANNExecutionProviderInfo& info) override {
    return std::make_shared<CANNProviderFactory>(info);
  }

  std::shared_ptr<IAllocator> CreateCannAllocator(int16_t device_id, size_t npu_mem_limit,
                                                  onnxruntime::ArenaExtendStrategy arena_extend_strategy,
                                                  OrtArenaCfg* default_memory_arena_cfg) override {
    return CANNExecutionProvider::CreateCannAllocator(device_id, npu_mem_limit, arena_extend_strategy,
                                                      default_memory_arena_cfg);
  }
} g_info;

struct CANN_Provider : Provider {
  void* GetInfo() override { return &g_info; }

  std::shared_ptr<IExecutionProviderFactory> CreateExecutionProviderFactory(const void* void_params) override {
    auto params = reinterpret_cast<const OrtCANNProviderOptions*>(void_params);

    CANNExecutionProviderInfo info{};
    info.device_id = static_cast<OrtDevice::DeviceId>(params->device_id);
    info.npu_mem_limit = params->npu_mem_limit;
    info.arena_extend_strategy = params->arena_extend_strategy;
    info.enable_cann_graph = params->enable_cann_graph != 0;
    info.enable_cann_subgraph = params->enable_cann_subgraph != 0;
    info.dump_graphs = params->dump_graphs != 0;
    info.dump_om_model = params->dump_om_model != 0;
    info.precision_mode = params->precision_mode;
    info.op_select_impl_mode = params->op_select_impl_mode;
    info.optypelist_for_implmode = params->optypelist_for_implmode;
    info.default_memory_arena_cfg = params->default_memory_arena_cfg;

    return std::make_shared<CANNProviderFactory>(info);
  }

  void UpdateProviderOptions(void* provider_options, const ProviderOptions& options) override {
    auto internal_options = onnxruntime::CANNExecutionProviderInfo::FromProviderOptions(options);
    auto& cann_options = *reinterpret_cast<OrtCANNProviderOptions*>(provider_options);

    cann_options.device_id = internal_options.device_id;
    cann_options.npu_mem_limit = internal_options.npu_mem_limit;
    cann_options.arena_extend_strategy = internal_options.arena_extend_strategy;
    cann_options.enable_cann_graph = internal_options.enable_cann_graph;
    cann_options.enable_cann_subgraph = internal_options.enable_cann_subgraph;
    cann_options.dump_graphs = internal_options.dump_graphs;
    cann_options.dump_om_model = internal_options.dump_om_model;
    cann_options.precision_mode = internal_options.precision_mode;
    cann_options.op_select_impl_mode = internal_options.op_select_impl_mode;
    cann_options.optypelist_for_implmode = internal_options.optypelist_for_implmode;
    cann_options.default_memory_arena_cfg = internal_options.default_memory_arena_cfg;
  }

  ProviderOptions GetProviderOptions(const void* provider_options) override {
    auto& options = *reinterpret_cast<const OrtCANNProviderOptions*>(provider_options);
    return onnxruntime::CANNExecutionProviderInfo::ToProviderOptions(options);
  }

  void Initialize() override {
    InitializeRegistry();
  }

  void Shutdown() override {
    DeleteRegistry();
  }
} g_provider;

}  // namespace onnxruntime

extern "C" {

ORT_API(onnxruntime::Provider*, GetProvider) {
  return &onnxruntime::g_provider;
}
}

} g_provider;

}

1）标题
[Bug][MhcPre] 动态维度 N=-1 转成 uint64 后进入阶乘循环，InferShape 无法终止
2）问题描述
MhcPre InferShape
第 134 行把 N 声明为
uint64_t
，第 139/142 行直接接收输入 shape 的维度，第 146 行立即计算
Factorial(n)
。在检查 N 是否为未知维度或有效取值前，已经进入：
static
uint64_t
Factorial
(
uint64_t
n)
{
uint64_t
r =
1
;
for
(
uint64_t
i =
2
; i <= n; ++i) {
        r *= i;
    }
return
r;
}
当动态 N=-1 时，转换结果为
UINT64_MAX
。循环条件始终成立，计数器溢出后还会从 0 继续，导致图形状推导卡住。即使不支持动态 N，也应该返回明确错误，而非进入该循环。
3）环境信息
目标：Ascend 950 配套 CANN 的 Host/GE InferShape；共享推导函数也需在 A2/A3 回归。
OpDef
声明动态 shape 支持。
本次未启动可能卡住的 CANN 回调；结论来自 C++ 无符号转换、循环条件与校验顺序。
4）重现步骤
在
现有 InferShape UT
中增加独立测试，输入描述为：
x: BF16 [1,1,-1,4096]
phi: FP32 [24,-1]
alpha: FP32 [3]
bias: FP32 [24]
gamma: 不提供
out_flag=1, norm_eps=1e-6, hc_eps=1e-6, op_impl_mode=0
为六个输出提供可写 shape 描述；这里只做 Host 形状推导，无需给未知 shape 分配设备数据。
在独立子进程中调用注册的 InferShape，设置 5 秒超时，并保留超时前调用栈。
对照组将
x.N=4
、
phi=[24,16384]
，比较推导能否正常返回。
5）预期结果
发现未知 N 时传播动态维度，或者对当前不支持的动态 N 快速返回失败。InferShape 必须终止，不能因负值转无符号数而长时间占用 CPU。
6）日志截图等
确定的语言层算术与代码路径，非实测超时日志：
输入 x.GetDim(2) = -1
uint64_t n = 18446744073709551615
Factorial(n) 在任何 N 合法性判断之前执行
对任意 uint64_t i，i <= UINT64_MAX 恒成立
定位：
Factorial
第 88～95 行；N 赋值及调用第 134～146 行。尚无真实 CANN 超时栈。
7）备注
应在转换类型及阶乘计算前检查未知维度和范围。建议同步检查其他负维度及超大 N，不把“支持动态 N”作为修复成立的前提。

[BugFix]fix DeepSeek-V4 PIECEWISE ACLGraph accuracy
## Summary



This PR fixes an accuracy issue for DeepSeek-V4 when running with PIECEWISE ACLGraph mode on Ascend.



DeepSeek-V4 DSA attention uses the Ascend custom op `vllm::dsa_forward`, but PIECEWISE splitting only added `vllm::mla_forward` as an Ascend custom attention boundary. As a result, the DSA attention path was not treated as a split boundary and could be captured inside a regular PIECEWISE graph segment, leading to incorrect outputs.



This change adds `vllm::dsa_forward` to `compilation_config.splitting_ops` together with `vllm::mla_forward`.



## Changes



- Add `vllm::dsa_forward` to PIECEWISE `splitting_ops`.



## Why



`vllm::dsa_forward` wraps the DeepSeek-V4 DSA attention path. It depends on runtime `forward_context` metadata, KV cache state, sparse attention metadata,and mutates the provided `output` tensor.



Because of these dynamic side effects, it must be handled as a PIECEWISE split boundary instead of being captured inside a normal graph segment.

        # get custom compile backend for graph fusion
        compilation_config.oot_compiler = cls.get_compile_backend()

        if compilation_config.cudagraph_mode == CUDAGraphMode.NONE:
            compilation_config.mode = CompilationMode.NONE
            ascend_config.ascend_compilation_config.enable_npugraph_ex = False
        elif compilation_config.cudagraph_mode == CUDAGraphMode.PIECEWISE:
            logger.info("PIECEWISE compilation enabled on NPU. use_inductor not supported - using only ACL Graph mode")
            assert compilation_config.mode == CompilationMode.VLLM_COMPILE, (
                "When enabling VLLM_COMPILE aclgraph, please make sure compilation_config.mode == "
                "CompilationMode.VLLM_COMPILE and compilation_config.cudagraph_mode == CUDAGraphMode.VLLM_COMPILE"
            )
            compilation_config.set_splitting_ops_for_v1(
                all2all_backend=vllm_config.parallel_config.all2all_backend,
                data_parallel_size=vllm_config.parallel_config.data_parallel_size,
            )
            compilation_config.use_inductor = False
            # NOTE: Theoretically, we should also add vllm::mla_forward in the attention ops.
            # Since the process is created in the spawn mode, the value of the class attribute
            # attention ops transmitted is still the one before modification, so it has not been modified.
            # This will cause in scenarios where both piecewise and splitting ops are configured simultaneously,
            # If splitting ops does not contain the vllm::mla forward value, this configuration issue will
            # not be detected in advance assert.
            compilation_config.splitting_ops.extend(["vllm::mla_forward", "vllm::dsa_forward"])
            update_aclgraph_sizes(vllm_config)
            ascend_config.ascend_compilation_config.enable_npugraph_ex = False
        elif (
            compilation_config.cudagraph_mode == CUDAGraphMode.FULL_DECODE_ONLY
            or compilation_config.cudagraph_mode == CUDAGraphMode.FULL
        ):
            logger.info(
                "FULL_DECODE_ONLY compilation enabled on NPU. use_inductor not supported - using only ACL Graph mode"
            )
            compilation_config.use_inductor = False
            compilation_config.splitting_ops = []

[Feature] Add 910C matmul-allreduce-rmsnorm fusion op for Qwen3 down-projection
### What this PR does / why we need it?

This PR adds a **fused matmul + allreduce + add + rmsnorm operator targeting Ascend 910C**, specialized for the **Qwen3 down-projection** path, and wires it through the vllm-ascend compilation graph-fusion layer.

**Background — different swim-lanes, converged onto this release.**
This fusion work was developed on a separate internal development branch (different "swim-lane" from the mainline v0.22.1rc work). It is contributed here on top of the current `releases/v0.22.1rc` baseline so the three-operator fusion (matmul → allreduce → rmsnorm) lands as a single coherent change on this release rather than as scattered commits. The four original development commits (which included WIP staging) have been squashed into this one clean commit for review.

**Why fusion helps.**
The Qwen3 down-projection normally issues a matmul, then an allreduce, then a residual add and an rmsnorm as separate kernels. Each is a separate kernel launch plus, for the collective, a host-device round trip. Fusing the four stages into one 910C op removes those launches and round trips, reducing the down-projection latency.

**What this PR adds:**

- `csrc/mc2/matmul_allreduce_add_rmsnorm_910c/`: the aclnn host adapter (def/proto/tiling/workspace), the aclnn torch entry, the AIC and AIV kernels, tiling, utils, and shared `moe_distribute` base/comm-context helpers.
- `csrc/` wiring: `CMakeLists` entries, `func.cmake` registration, `torch_binding.cpp` / `torch_binding_

Sep 13

关联 Issue
修复 #686
问题
FSDP2 训练使用
BaseRandomBatchSampler
且
shuffle=True
时，
training.seed
已正确传入 sampler（trainer.py 中
seed=args.training.seed
），但 sampler 内部
g.manual_seed(self.epoch)
只用 epoch 初始化，完全忽略
self.seed
，导致不同 seed 产生完全相同的采样顺序（
data_sharding
两种路径均如此）。
修复
两处
g.manual_seed(self.epoch)
改为
g.manual_seed(self.seed + self.epoch)
，与本文件既有约定一致（
VariableVideoBatchSampler
:729、
AESampler
:939/
get_bucket
:835、
LuminaMetaLenDistSampler
:1022 均用
self.seed + self.epoch
）。
同一缺陷也存在于非 FSDP 版的
BaseRandomBatchSampler.__iter__
（sampler.py :455/:466）及其子类
BucketBatchSampler
（:644/:655）——同一文件、同样的手写 generator 模式，一并对齐修复，避免同类 issue 重复上报。
验证
运行 issue 最小复现脚本，修复前两条路径
same_order=True
，修复后
same_order=False
；
epoch
递增仍会改变顺序（保留原 epoch 相关性）。
兼容性
种子语义从“仅 epoch”变为“seed+epoch”，顺序本身会变化（这正是 issue 期望的行为）；state_dict 格式不变。
